g.text: Intelligent pipeline decision for enterprise tasks. Describe your goal, upload your dataset or document, and EasyLLM autonomously constructs
the optimal RAG or fine-tuned model.
Supports DOCX, PDF, JSONL, CSV & TXT · Real GPU/CPU pipeline execution
Build a customer support AI that answers employee and client questions
using our company refund and warranty handbook with strict citations.
Select or drop dataset or document
Your requirement demands strict factual citations on company policy. RAG provides exact source attribution,
zero training hallucination, and instantaneous index updates.
EasyLLM inspects task requirements and token formats to automatically route to the optimal architecture:
Selected for policies, manuals, handbooks & documentation.
Selected for conversational tone, persona & style adaptation.
Pairs fine-tuned adapter responses with real-time vector retrieval.
How EasyLLM Automates Your Model Architecture
Zero manual hyperparameter tuning. From plain English description to a verified, deployed AI.
Extracts text, paragraphs, and conversation turns from Word (.docx), PDF, JSONL, or CSV documents.
Decision engine determines knowledge density vs persona needs and selects RAG, QLoRA, or Hybrid.
Executes parameter-efficient PyTorch LoRA fine-tuning and dense neural vector embeddings with live logs.
Generates side-by-side baseline comparisons, metric evaluations, source citations, and chat playgrounds.
EasyLLM Autonomous Model Architect • Next.js 14 • Tailwind CSS • FastAPI Backend
